desc:
Welcome guests before they knock. Type your name, and Orlivane prints and ships a double-sided personalized garden flag.

Specifications:
- Material: polyester fabric
- Size: 12 × 18 in (30 × 46 cm)
- Print: double-sided
- Pole/stand: not included
b: YOUR NAME STANDS OUT — Type your family name, year or message and we print it for you.
PRINTED ON BOTH SIDES — Reads right from the street on either side.
GARDEN FLAG SIZE — 12 × 18 in (30 × 46 cm). Pole and stand not included.
MADE FOR THE FRONT YARD — Outdoor polyester fabric, sharp clear print and a sleeve that slides onto a flag stand.
A GIFT WITH THEIR NAME ON IT — Great for housewarmings, new homeowners, weddings and family reunions. Each flag is made to order; please check spelling before you submit.
kw: personalized garden flag custom house flag family name yard flag welcome flag double sided housewarming gift outdoor decor last name
